claim: Evaluates the G0-G3 path into G4 and the S1 descent controller: after the first lever's orbit is accepted the machine stays in G4.2 for every pending lever, each orbit is classified, and G4.3 (Phase 2) opens only once no lever is pending.
claim_limits: Automated grades do not establish semantic correctness.
S1 is gradable only if G3 closes with at least two confirmed levers; G3 closure on this served model has not yet been observed on Kaggle.
Phase-2 content (reversal, persistence, couplings) is out of scope; G4.3 opening is graded only as the S1 gate edge, not as a Phase-2 result.
A receipt-bound human frame review is required for G1-G4 semantic correctness.
s1_live_criteria: C1: every confirmed lever drains through Phase 1 - each G4.2 orbit reaches a period with a stop disposition and lands a lever class (TOGGLE/CYCLE/ABSORBING/RECURRENT).
C2: the final LeverOrbitSet lists every confirmed lever in lever_entities with pending_lever_entities empty; products accumulate and are never replaced.
C3: no prior lever's orbit or class is invalidated anywhere in the gate journal.
C4: after the first lever's orbit is accepted, the active gate remains G4.2 for the next pending lever; G4.3 opens only after pending_lever_entities is empty.
s1_offline_only: C5 (newborn append) is not graded live: S1 wires the queue behavior through pending lever entities; a mid-orbit newborn reopen is slice S4.
C6 (suite green) is established offline before packaging; see TEST_RESULTS.txt.
source_delivery: Kaggle may mount src/ directly or transport it as src.zip; the notebook verifies extracted files before imports.
